description: ES256 on a set holding one EC private key returns it with its private member d; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (the P-256 member serves ES256) and §3: EC members are returned as imported, private parts included (the caller calls to_public before publishing one), so the returned key carries d (RFC 7518 §6.2.2.1); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
